question: Where should the mantra limbs and the all-pervading goddess be worshipped?
premises: The limbs are to be worshipped in the six corners.
The all-pervading goddess is to be worshipped on the left side.
Both acts are prescribed as worship.
inference: One should worship the limbs in the six corners and the all-pervading goddess on the left side.
plain_english: One should worship the limbs in the six corners and the all-pervading goddess on the left side.
